commons.description:
Drawing by Theodor de Bry, from Regnum Congo hoc est vera descriptio regni Africani (Filippo Pigafetta, 1598)
Caption: De Regni Co[ngi]ani incolis & Anziquis, de quibus cap. 5 primi libri fit mentio.
commons.editorial_reason: Historical engraving is sourced from the Imbangala article and depicts attributed people in traditional dress engaged in a visibly cultural/historical scene; no clear blood or graphic slaughter is visible.
